post.caption: Egyptian gods had silver bones. In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Ra has silver bones and golden flesh. Gold came from Egypt's own Eastern Desert and from Nubia, while silver had to be brought in from abroad. Temple inscriptions suggest silver outranked gold for much of Egypt's history. The Egyptian word hedj meant both white and silver. Queen Hetepheres owned silver bracelets from around 2600 BCE, and lab tests suggest their silver came from the Greek islands. Tutankhamun's tomb held a silver trumpet trimmed with gold. It was played on BBC radio in 1939.
